definitions.explanation: The foot or leg on the left side of the body. As with {足|あし}, the word covers either the foot specifically or the whole leg, with context distinguishing the two.

examples.japanese: {左足|ひだりあし}が{痛|いた}い。
{左足|ひだりあし}を{骨折|こっせつ}してしまった。
{彼|かれ}は{左足|ひだりあし}でボールを{蹴|け}るのが{得意|とくい}だ。
examples.english: He is good at kicking the ball with his left foot.

notes:
Like {足|あし} itself, this word does not distinguish foot from leg; context decides. For an unambiguous reference to the leg above the ankle, use {左|ひだり}{脚|あし} (written with the leg-specific kanji {脚|あし}) or pair with a body-part word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {左足|ひだりあし}で{蹴|け}る: to kick with the left foot
- {左足|ひだりあし}を{痛|いた}める: to injure one's left foot/leg
- {左足|ひだりあし}から{歩|ある}き{出|だ}す: to step off with the left foot

RELATED FORMS:
- {右足|みぎあし}: right foot/leg
- {両足|りょうあし}: both feet/legs
- {片足|かたあし}: one foot/leg
